situations.headline: Synertec wins $45.5m govt engineering contract, transformational for revenue visibility to FY35

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Synertec wins $45.5m govt engineering contract, transformational for revenue visibility to FY35 (interest 7, risk 4)

thesis.text: Synertec's award of a large, multi-year government infrastructure engineering contract materially de-risks and extends the company's revenue runway without incremental capex, positioning it as a credible small-cap infrastructure engineering partner; the key near-term catalyst is the pending FY27 guidance update that will clarify revenue timing and recognition, which should be monitored closely as it will determine whether the market re-rates the stock on realized (vs. headline) contract value.
